identity_check: Confirmed as Faclon Labs (faclon.com), the industrial IoT / industrial AI company started in Mumbai in 2016 by IIT-Bombay alumni. The leadership on faclon.com/about-us (Rishi Sharma CEO, Utkarsh Srivastava CTO, Archit Naraniwal Chief Sales Officer) matches the founders named by Entrepreneur India (2021) and Inc42. Offices are in Andheri East, Mumbai and Dublin, California (LinkedIn and Tracxn now give Dublin as HQ). It is not Falkonry, FalconX, Falcon Labs or other similarly spelled companies that appear in searches. Category kept 'direct' and layer 'plant_ops'. Its Faclon Intelligence Platform connects plant machines and monitors energy, maintenance (condition monitoring), production and safety. It adds an AI copilot (Bruce AI) built on SOPs and manuals for diagnostics and root-cause analysis, and the company markets agentic AI for factories in metals, cement, auto parts, chemicals, pharma and FMCG. These are the plant-ops functions Utopian Autonomy targets. The difference is that Faclon delivers through IoT hardware plus dashboards and a copilot; no WhatsApp interface was seen.

open_items: No press or company page found for the 2022-2025 rounds that Tracxn lists (Jul 2022, Aug 2024, Mar 2025 and Oct 2025 'Series A'; Sep 2023 'Angel'). Amounts are masked on Tracxn, so the total raised is unverified. Tracxn's figure ($5.26M over 9 rounds) is database-only.

Tracxn also lists unnamed rounds on May 04, 2017 and Feb 17, 2020, and Inc42 lists a separate Seed entry on 18 Dec 2017 ('LetsVenture, +3 more'). These are not recorded separately: the Dec 2017 entry is probably a tranche of the January 2018 angel round, and the other two have no type or investors.

Grants not recorded as equity rounds: 'ENTICE 2.0 by GEAPP Grant Winners 2025' (about page), which Tracxn lists as Grant (prize money) from Energy Alliance on Aug 29, 2025, and 'UNIDO-CII Pilot Funding Winners 2021' (about page).

Revenue not recorded. The Inc42 database profile shows ₹11.7 Cr in FY25, down 16.5% from ₹14.0 Cr in FY24, and Tracxn gives a ₹10-50 Cr band as of Mar 31, 2025. No fetched press article reports the MCA revenue: TheKredible's FY24 revenue article returned HTTP 530.
Valuation not recorded. Inc42 says the 'last known valuation was $2.71 million as of 03 March 2021' (database only), and Tracxn masks its Jan 13, 2026 valuation.

Investors named by databases but not tied to a round: Neev Angel Advisors (Inc42 FAQ), and Empower India and Street Smart Financial (Tracxn). The BW Disrupt article on the 2018 seed round returned 403.
Customer logos for LG Electronics, Coca-Cola and SRF appear only as image filenames on faclon.com, so they are not recorded as named customers.
The web-search budget ran out before ET, VCCircle and Moneycontrol could be checked for 2022-2026 Faclon funding news.

company.name: Faclon Labs
company.description: Mumbai-founded industrial IoT and AI platform that connects plant equipment, tracks energy, maintenance and production, and adds an AI copilot for diagnostics.

layer_detail: Industrial IoT and AI operations platform (Faclon Intelligence Platform). It covers connectivity over Modbus, OPC, LoRa and HART (I/O Connect), dashboards and alerts (I/O Sense), no-code ML (I/O DeepSense) and the Bruce AI copilot, whose knowledge graph is built from SOPs and manuals. Solutions span energy and utilities, maintenance (condition-based monitoring and a maintenance management system), production and safety, and the company is pushing 'agentic AI' and an 'SEC-RCA Agent'. Delivered through dashboards and a copilot; no WhatsApp channel seen.
product_summary: Faclon Intelligence Platform: modular industrial IoT and AI software that connects machines over industrial protocols, provides dashboards, reports and alerts (I/O Sense), no-code forecasting models (I/O DeepSense) and a conversational copilot (Bruce AI) for diagnostics and root-cause analysis, applied to energy, maintenance, production and safety in plants.
